content: Amiya cannot help but follow this voice in delving into the depths of 'Civilight Eterna', fumbling about amidst countless fragments of space and time.

raw: A ring chafes against the palm of her hand.
content: A ring chafes against the palm of her hand.

raw: If only she could remove them, she would be privy to secrets ancient and new, and all the details of the past will flow into her brain.
content: If only she could remove them, she would be privy to secrets ancient and new, and all the details of the past will flow into her brain.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Not now, Amiya.

speaker: Amiya
content: Dr. Kal'tsit...

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]You are being influenced by the myriad souls. In their impatience, they are willing you to accept their choice.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: You are being influenced by the myriad souls. In their impatience, they are willing you to accept their choice.

speaker: Amiya
content: I wish to understand... her emotions.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]Then you must face her. We must all do so.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Then you must face her. We must all do so.

raw: [Decision(options="She's right, Amiya.;We'll do it together.", values="1;2")]
options: She's right, Amiya.;We'll do it together.

speaker: Amiya
content: I know.

raw: [name="Amiya"]Other than the myriad souls outside, I can hear the voices of your hearts clearly. The Doctor's, Dr. Kal'tsit's, W's.
speaker: Amiya
content: Other than the myriad souls outside, I can hear the voices of your hearts clearly. The Doctor's, Dr. Kal'tsit's, W's.

raw: [name="W"]Those who dare use Arts on me to peep at my thoughts tend not to last too long.
speaker: W
content: Those who dare use Arts on me to peep at my thoughts tend not to last too long.

raw: [name="W"]But... Heh, since we made it this far, I bet we're pretty much thinking the same thing anyway.
speaker: W
content: But... Heh, since we made it this far, I bet we're pretty much thinking the same thing anyway.

raw: Urgency, nervousness, and a brimming anticipation.
content: Urgency, nervousness, and a brimming anticipation.

raw: All vivid emotions that contrast with the echoes in the deathly silence.
content: All vivid emotions that contrast with the echoes in the deathly silence.

raw: [name="Amiya"]Let's go up together. We're very close now.
speaker: Amiya
content: Let's go up together. We're very close now.

raw: [name="W"]Let me have a think on how we should tear down this transparent ceiling.
speaker: W
content: Let me have a think on how we should tear down this transparent ceiling.

speaker: Amiya
content: Perhaps...

speaker: Amiya
content: She has already told me how.

raw: An eye within the darkness hangs above their heads.
content: An eye within the darkness hangs above their heads.
A rhombus.

raw: It appears to be the only light in the darkness, as if it is the one that devoured the brilliance of all other things.
content: It appears to be the only light in the darkness, as if it is the one that devoured the brilliance of all other things.
Amiya raises her head.

raw: Every King of Sarkaz amongst the myriad souls raises their head.
content: Every King of Sarkaz amongst the myriad souls raises their head.

raw: Amiya stretches her hand out towards the rhombus.
content: Amiya stretches her hand out towards the rhombus.

raw: Every King of Sarkaz amongst the myriad souls stretches their hand out.
content: Every King of Sarkaz amongst the myriad souls stretches their hand out.

raw: These were the only words left to me by the first King of Sarkaz:
content: These were the only words left to me by the first King of Sarkaz:

raw: 'The stone that enshrouds us like night is our suffering, and our hope.'
content: 'The stone that enshrouds us like night is our suffering, and our hope.'

raw: We came here because of hope.
content: We came here because of hope.

raw: At this moment, the Farchaser, the Citymaker, the Wrathful Cerulean Flame... All the Kings of Sarkaz are with me. Even Yliš takes up his staff once more.
content: At this moment, the Farchaser, the Citymaker, the Wrathful Cerulean Flame... All the Kings of Sarkaz are with me. Even Yliš takes up his staff once more.
They fight alongside me.

raw: For the sake of our shared duty.
content: For the sake of our shared duty.
The duty of the Kings.

raw: The future of the Sarkaz will be revealed here.
content: The future of the Sarkaz will be revealed here.

raw: Heaven and earth, up and down, light and dark, past and future.
content: Heaven and earth, up and down, light and dark, past and future.

raw: All of a sudden, they are reversed.
content: All of a sudden, they are reversed.

raw: At the top of the tower that is also its base, at the end that is also its beginning, Amiya hears a sigh.
content: At the top of the tower that is also its base, at the end that is also its beginning, Amiya hears a sigh.
We have been waiting for you...
'King of Sarkaz'.
